svg.text: COLLECT ABOVE · GROW BELOW · SECTION & LIGHT PATH · VOLUME III · SHEET 1 OF 5

g.text: ⚠ A WINDOW IS A HOLE IN YOUR SHELTER
A GLAZED DOME IS A RADIATION HOLE WITH CROPS IN IT. SPLIT THE WINDOW'S TWO JOBS: COLLECT ABOVE, DELIVER BELOW.
EXPOSURE IS FREE — NOBODY STANDS HERE
PRESSURISED VAULT — NO TRANSPARENT ROOF, NO VIEW OF THE SKY
STACKED RACKS — BURIED VOLUME IS EXPENSIVE PER CUBIC METRE
BURIAL IS NOT MERELY TOLERABLE HERE —
THAT IS WHY LEAVES LOOK GREEN
A LAMP CAN SEND ONLY THE USEFUL BANDS.
! THE LIGHT BUDGET IS THE WHOLE PROBLEM
THE BIOLOGY IS EASY. PLANTS GROW FINE UNDER LAMPS.
THE COST IS PHOTONS × AREA × HOURS — AND IT SCALES WITH APPETITE.
GROWING AREA IS LIMITED BY AVAILABLE ENERGY, NOT BY EXCAVATION.
ON THE MOON IT MUST ALSO SURVIVE A FOURTEEN-DAY NIGHT.
EVERY PHOTON MUST BE COLLECTED, CARRIED, AND DELIVERED — EACH STEP LOSES.
WARM, HUMID, PRESSURISED: UNKIND TO ELECTRONICS, KIND TO MOULDS.
AND IT TAKES AWAY THE VIEW — A REAL LOSS, EVEN IF NOT AN ENGINEERING ONE.
RESIST THE GLAZED SURFACE DOME. IT PHOTOGRAPHS WELL AND SHIELDS NOTHING.
